annotation.title_clean: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.title_en: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ruler of Dubai (Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum); Supreme Legislation Committee in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.summary_en: Dubai Law No. 9 of 2023 regulates autonomous vehicle operation in the Emirate. It gives the RTA powers over licensing, inspection, permits and standards, sets duties for operators, agents and passengers, makes operators civilly liable for damage, applies existing criminal law to AV acts, and sets fines of AED 500–50,000.
key_provisions_or_claims: No AV may travel on roads without an RTA licence; activities require RTA permits.
Licensing requires inspection, insurance, traffic-sign recognition, safety standards, and sourcing from the authorised local agent.
Modifications or updates to the driving system need prior RTA approval.
Operators are liable for damage caused by AVs, with recourse against responsible parties; the RTA is not liable.
Existing criminal law applies to acts committed by AVs; fines range from AED 500 to 50,000.
